news.title: Spain’s AS Claims Bernabéu Remains Favorite to Host 2030 World Cup Final
news.lede: Rabat – Spanish media coverage of the 2030 World Cup final continues to intensify after Royal Moroccan Football Federation President Fouzi Lekjaa declared that the Hassan II Stadium in Beslimane would host the tournament’s showpiece match. Lekjaa made the declaration during a political gathering in Benslimane, presenting the planned 115,000-capacity stadium as the venue for the tournament’s decisive match. FIFA subsequently rejected any suggestion that the venue had already been determined, saying the decision would be made at a later stage. AS points to Bernabéu AS has now weighed in on the dispute, reporting that the current outlook still favors Madrid’s Santiago Bernabéu.

news.title: 1990 UAE World Cup heroes' reunion sends message beyond football
news.lede: Abu Dhabi: The reception hosted by President His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan for the national team stars who represented the country at the 1990 World Cup in Italy was more than a celebration of a landmark achievement in Emirati football. It became a message linking the past, present and future. Thirty-six years after the UAE's first World Cup appearance, members of that historic generation returned to the spotlight through what many described as a message of loyalty and recognition. Among those honoured were Saeed Salboukh, Adnan Al Talyani, Abdullah Mousa, Abdul Qader Hassan, Mohsen Musabbeh, Abdullah Sultan, Khalil Ghanem, Ibrahim Mir, Issa Mir, Youssef Hussein, Hassan Ali, Abdul Aziz Mohammed, Fahad Khamis, Ali Thani, Hassan Mohammed Bolo, Fahad Abdul Rahman, Farouk Abdul Rahman, Zuhair Bakhit, Salem Rabie, Mohammed Salem Radwan and Abdul Rahman Al Haddad.

news.title: Time for Pocognoli to pick - who could be named in new-look Scotland squad?
news.lede: Sebastien Pocognoli is about to begin his Scotland reign in earnest. A new Scotland dawn is on the horizon. On Tuesday, Sebastien Pocognoli will name his first squad since being appointed the national team's head coach for the upcoming Nations League B fixtures. His predecessor, Steve Clarke, prioritised consistency in his squad during his successful seven-year reign, which ultimately culminated in a first men's World Cup appearance in 28 years.

news.title: Revealed: Why Barcelona sensation Lamine Yamal 'wasn't happy' at World Cup despite securing global glory with Spain
news.lede: Lingering disappointment despite global gloryYamal enjoyed a spectacular campaign for both club and country, cementing his status as one of global football's brightest talents. The 19-year-old registered 24 goals and 18 assists for Barcelona last season, securing La Liga and the Spanish Super Cup in the process.His crowning achievement came on the international stage as Spain lifted the World Cup. However, the teenage sensation managed just a single goal and zero assists across eight appearances during the tournament. Instead, the forward pointed to his own sky-high standards."
